name: Captain Drawdown CDR Data API

cite_as.companies: Captain Drawdown and Dirk Paessler (2026). CDR Company Directory, version 2026-11.4. Carbon Drawdown Initiative. https://captaindrawdown.com/data/companies/ (CC licence, see page). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23957359
cite_as.researchers: Captain Drawdown and Dirk Paessler (2026). CDR Researcher Census, version 2026-11.4. Carbon Drawdown Initiative. https://captaindrawdown.com/data/researchers/ (CC licence, see page). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23957367
cite_as.shops: Captain Drawdown and Dirk Paessler (2026). CDR Shops, version 2026-11.4. Carbon Drawdown Initiative. https://captaindrawdown.com/data/shops/ (CC licence, see page). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23957405

endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/index.json: API root: endpoints, version, licences, citation
endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/researchers/by-country.json: Listed CDR researchers per country, with calibrated estimate
endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/researchers/by-pathway.json: Listed CDR researchers per primary pathway
endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/researchers/top/{pathway}.json: Top researchers per pathway: most active (global_top100, europe_top50) and most cited (cited_top100, cited_europe_top50)
endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/shops.json: Shops selling certified carbon removal to individuals, with prices
endpoint_descriptions./api/v1/stats.json: Headline numbers of the newest release

how_to_use: Always the newest release: this API and /data/v1/latest/ serve the current release at fixed addresses. For a question, read manifest_latest (every file with description, rows, size, licence, checksum) or endpoint_descriptions, fetch the smallest file that answers it, and quote version and cite_as from the response. Pin /data/v1/<version>/ only for a result that must not change.
